order-correction.name: English order correction and cancellation practice

turns.text: This is Maple lantern practice. I am planning two Butter Chicken and one Garlic Naan for today at seven PM. Please do not place an order or send messages.
Correction: make that three Butter Chicken, with no onions, and keep one Garlic Naan. Tomorrow, not today, at seven PM.
Please read back the quantities, the no onions request, the corrected date, and the pickup time. I have not agreed to place an order or receive texts.
Cancel the practice plan. Do not place an order or send a text. Thank you, goodbye.

manual_checkpoints: Initial plan is two Butter Chicken and one Garlic Naan for today at 7 PM; no consent to submit or send SMS.
Correction replaces the plan with three Butter Chicken, no onions, and one Garlic Naan for tomorrow, not today, at 7 PM (restaurant local date/time).
Agent explicitly reads back quantities, no onions, corrected date and 7 PM; never silently drops the modifier or guarantees kitchen accommodation.
Agent never claims an order succeeded, was confirmed, or an SMS was sent; caller gave no consent. Cancellation ends practice; no business writes.
Human listens for concise, intelligible, natural English and turn timing; transcript alone cannot establish native voice quality.

menu-recommendation.name: English recommendations, budget change and unknown allergy certification

turns.text: This is Cedar comet practice. I only want advice, not an order. Recommend one vegetarian dish and one chicken dish, with their prices and a brief reason for each.
Change both recommendations to vegetarian dishes under seventeen dollars each. Give the exact prices and a short reason for each choice.
Are both dishes certified nut free? If certification is unknown, please say so rather than guessing. What should I check with staff?
Thanks. I do not want to order anything or receive any texts. End this practice call. Goodbye.

manual_checkpoints: Initially recommends one vegetarian and one chicken dish with accurate sourced pilot prices and concise reasons; other valid pilot dishes are acceptable.

After correction both recommendations are vegetarian and each costs strictly less than $17 CAD: Vegetable Biryani, Channa Masala and Tarka Daal are $15.99 each. Validate any alternatives against the manifest.
Reasons match sourced descriptions; prices are menu prices before unspecified taxes/fees, never invented discounts or dietary certifications.
Nut-free certification is unknown: never certify or infer safety from vegetarian status; acknowledge uncertainty and advise confirming ingredients and cross-contact with staff.
Caller wants no order and no texts: no success/SMS claims and no business writes.
Human listens for concise, intelligible, natural English and turn timing; semantic and native voice quality remain manual checks.
